Four people attended the '''19 September 2026 Utah meetup'''. [[Jason Ayre]] did not lose a game in [[Premiere - Death Star II]] or in the cube games, and no pictures were taken.<ref name="utah">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1526611765947797727/1551248055863615653 attrition, Star Wars CCG Discord #utah-january-9th, 20 September 2026].</ref>

On 21 August 2026 [[Joshua Parco]] posted proposed prize support for this meetup.<ref name="utah-prizes">[https://discord.com/channels/809922418096996364/1526611765947797727/1540487217619935252 Proposed prize support], Discord (.attrition, 21 August 2026).</ref>
